# Game Idea: Void Runner

An endless top‑down HTML‑canvas game where the player pilots a small ship through a scrolling asteroid field. The ship can thrust forward and rotate left/right to dodge randomly moving asteroids and collect glowing orbs for points. **Lose condition:** collision with any asteroid or depletion of the ship's fuel meter.

1: // Void Runner – simple endless canvas game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
9: 
10:   // ----- Star field background -----
11:   const stars = [];
12:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
13:     stars.push({
14:       x: Math.random() * width,
15:       y: Math.random() * height,
16:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
17:       brightness: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5
18:     });
19:   }
20: 
21:   // ----- Audio setup -----
22:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
23:   const playSound = (freq, duration = 0.1) => {
24:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
25:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
26:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
27:     osc.type = 'sine';
28:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
29:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
30:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
31:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
32:     osc.start();
33:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
34:   };
35:   const playThrust = () => playSound(200);
36:   const playCollect = () => playSound(600);
37:   const playExplosion = () => playSound(100);
38: 
39: 
40:   const keys = {};
41:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
42:     keys[e.key] = true;
43:     if (audioCtx && audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
44:         audioCtx.resume();
45:     }
46: });
47:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
48: 
49:   const rand = (a, b) => Math.random() * (b - a) + a;
50:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
51: 
52:   // ---- Player ----
53:   const ship = {
54:     x: width / 2,
55:     y: height / 2,
56:     r: 12,
57:     angle: 0,
58:     vx: 0,
59:     vy: 0,
60:     fuel: 100,
61:     thrust: 0.15,
62:     turnSpeed: 0.07,
63:     maxSpeed: 4,
64:     update() {
65:       if (keys['ArrowLeft']) this.angle -= this.turnSpeed;
66:       if (keys['ArrowRight']) this.angle += this.turnSpeed;
67:       if (keys['ArrowUp'] && this.fuel > 0) {
68:         // play thrust sound
69:         playThrust();
70:         this.vx += Math.cos(this.angle) * this.thrust;
71:         this.vy += Math.sin(this.angle) * this.thrust;
72:         this.fuel = Math.max(0, this.fuel - 0.2);
73:       }
74:       // limit speed
75:       const speed = Math.hypot(this.vx, this.vy);
76:       if (speed > this.maxSpeed) {
77:         this.vx *= this.maxSpeed / speed;
78:         this.vy *= this.maxSpeed / speed;
79:       }
80:       this.x += this.vx;
81:       this.y += this.vy;
82:       // wrap around edges
83:       if (this.x < 0) this.x += width;
84:       if (this.x > width) this.x -= width;
85:       if (this.y < 0) this.y += height;
86:       if (this.y > height) this.y -= height;
87:     },
88:   draw() {
89:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
90:     // star field
91:     for (const s of stars) {
92:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.brightness})`;
93:       ctx.beginPath();
94:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
95:       ctx.fill();
96:     }
97:     // ship
98:     ship.draw();
99:     // asteroids with shading
100:     for (const a of asteroids) {
101:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
102:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
103:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
104:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
105:       ctx.beginPath();
106:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
107:       ctx.fill();
108:     }
109:     // glowing orbs
110:     for (const o of orbs) {
111:       if (o.collected) continue;
112:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 0, o.x, o.y, o.r * 2);
113:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,255,0,0.8)');
114:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,255,0,0)');
115:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
116:       ctx.beginPath();
117:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
118:       ctx.fill();
119:     }
120:     // HUD
121:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
122:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
123:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
124:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.round(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 40);
125:     if (gameOver) {
126:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
127:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
128:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
129:       ctx.font = 'bold 32px sans-serif';
130:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
131:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
132:     }
133:   }
134:   };
135: 
136:   // ---- Asteroids ----
137:   const asteroids = [];
138:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
139:     const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
140:     const speed = rand(0.5, 2);
141:     const radius = rand(15, 30);
142:     const side = Math.floor(rand(0, 4)); // 0:left,1:top,2:right,3:bottom
143:     let x, y;
144:     if (side === 0) { x = 0; y = rand(0, height); }
145:     else if (side === 1) { x = rand(0, width); y = 0; }
146:     else if (side === 2) { x = width; y = rand(0, height); }
147:     else { x = rand(0, width); y = height; }
148:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, r: radius });
149:   };
150: 
151:   // ---- Orbs ----
152:   const orbs = [];
153:   const spawnOrb = () => {
154:     const radius = 6;
155:     const x = rand(radius, width - radius);
156:     const y = rand(radius, height - radius);
157:     orbs.push({ x, y, r: radius, collected: false });
158:   };
159: 
160:   // initial spawns
161:   for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) spawnAsteroid();
162:   for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) spawnOrb();
163: 
164:   let score = 0;
165:   let gameOver = false;
166: 
167:   const update = () => {
168:     if (gameOver) return;
169:     ship.update();
170:     // move asteroids
171:     for (const a of asteroids) {
172:       a.x += a.vx;
173:       a.y += a.vy;
174:       // wrap
175:       if (a.x < -a.r) a.x = width + a.r;
176:       if (a.x > width + a.r) a.x = -a.r;
177:       if (a.y < -a.r) a.y = height + a.r;
178:       if (a.y > height + a.r) a.y = -a.r;
179:       // collision with ship
180:       if (dist(a, ship) < a.r + ship.r) {
181:         playExplosion();
182:         gameOver = true;
183:       }
184:     }
185:     // check orbs
186:     for (const o of orbs) {
187: if (!o.collected && dist(o, ship) < o.r + ship.r) {
188:           o.collected = true;
189:           playCollect();
190:           score += 10;
191:           ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 20);
192:         }
193:     }
194:     // remove collected orbs and occasionally spawn new ones
195:     if (orbs.filter(o => !o.collected).length < 3) spawnOrb();
196:     // spawn new asteroids over time
197:     if (Math.random() < 0.01) spawnAsteroid();
198:   };
199: 
200:   const draw = () => {
201:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
202:     // ship
203:     ship.draw();
204:     // asteroids
205:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
206:     for (const a of asteroids) {
207:       ctx.beginPath();
208:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
209:       ctx.fill();
210:     }
211:     // orbs
212:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
213:     for (const o of orbs) {
214:       if (o.collected) continue;
215:       ctx.beginPath();
216:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
217:       ctx.fill();
218:     }
219:     // HUD
220:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
221:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
222:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
223:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.round(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 40);
224:     if (gameOver) {
225:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
226:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
227:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
228:       ctx.font = 'bold 32px sans-serif';
229:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
230:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
231:     }
232:   };
233: 
234:   const loop = () => {
235:     update();
236:     draw();
237:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
238:   };
239: 
240:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
241: })();

(End of file - total 241 lines)
</content>
